preamble.summary: Psalm 61 (MT) / Psalm 60 (LXX) is a short Davidic royal-petition — eight verses — framing the pilgrimage-prayer 'from the end of the earth I call to you' and the signature petition 'lead me to the rock that is higher than I' (v. 2). The psalm's royal-prayer-for-long-life (v. 6, 'prolong the king's life') dovetails with the Messianic-eternal-reign theology.
preamble.notable_variants: 61:2 'lead me to the rock that is higher than I' as refuge-metaphor; 61:4 'shelter of your wings' (skepē tōn pterygōn) as protection-imagery; 61:6–7 royal-life-prolongation prayer with Messianic-extension.
preamble.structural_notes: MT Ps 61 = LXX Ps 60. 9 verses (MT/LXX), 8 verses (English).

variant_notes: 'Hear my cry, O God, listen to my prayer' tracks MT.

'From the end of the earth I call to you when my heart is faint' tracks MT. 'LEAD ME TO THE ROCK THAT IS HIGHER THAN I' — the rock-higher-than-self as divine-refuge-metaphor. Matthew 7:24–27's wise-builder-on-rock parable and 1 Corinthians 10:4's 'that rock was Christ' extend the rock-theology Christologically.
'For you have been my refuge, a strong tower against the enemy' tracks MT.
'Let me dwell in your tent forever! Let me take refuge under the shelter of your wings!' tracks MT. TENT-AND-WINGS imagery paired: sanctuary-dwelling + avian-protection.
'For you, O God, have heard my vows; you have given me the heritage of those who fear your name' tracks MT.

'Prolong the life of the king; may his years endure to all generations' tracks MT. ROYAL-LIFE-PROLONGATION prayer. Messianically-extended, the petition becomes prayer for the Messiah's eternal-reign. Hebrews 7:24–25 ('he holds his priesthood permanently, because he continues forever') develops the eternal-priest-king-life theology.

'May he be enthroned forever before God; appoint steadfast love and faithfulness to watch over him!' tracks MT. 'Enthroned forever before God' — the Messianic-eternal-enthronement (Heb 1:13, 10:12 developing Ps 110:1's 'sit at my right hand').
'So will I ever sing praises to your name, as I perform my vows day after day' tracks MT.
